purpose: Complete core AgentSwitchboard autoconfiguration without allowing Hermes installation or repair to block the operator. Hermes is recorded as deferred/TBD and may be repaired later.

steps.name: resolve repository root
steps.action: Verify the selected directory contains .git and tooling/gnhf/Setup-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 before any fetch or setup command. Reject stale hard-coded user-profile paths.

steps.name: select shell
steps.action: Run setup from PowerShell 7. PowerShell aliases such as irm are not CMD commands; do not paste a PowerShell installer pipeline into cmd.exe.

steps.name: defer Hermes
steps.action: Invoke tooling/gnhf/Setup-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 with -InstallOpenCodeAndCopilot -SkipHermesInstall. Do not manually install Hermes during the core-autoconfig lane.

steps.name: preserve setup evidence
steps.action: Resolve the fresh setup-summary.json and setup-transcript.txt from the artifact registry. Hermes skipped/blocked is acceptable only when the core fleet install completed and the setup itself did not fail.

steps.name: list readiness
steps.action: Run the installed agent-switchboard.cmd -ListAgents or the repository startup report. Mark Hermes TBD/deferred when unavailable; continue with other READY adapters.

steps.name: handoff
steps.action: Report repository root, setup artifact paths, Hermes=TBD/deferred, observed READY adapters, and the exact next bounded-work command.

forbidden: manual Hermes installation during this workflow
running git outside a verified repository root
using CMD for a PowerShell-only installer pipeline
proofCeiling: Proves the deterministic non-blocking core-autoconfig route and its required evidence. It does not prove Hermes availability, provider authentication, or hosted model response.
